payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-23: the capped release check on 92d37ba (owner, 22 Oct) stopped check:production-readiness at the privacy gate on exactly these owner sign-offs: PRIV-PROVIDER-OPENAI-ZDR (pending; OpenAI has not approved the 1 Sept request, so chase OpenAI or record restricted use in writing), PRIV-LEGAL-APP8-CROSS-BORDER-BASIS (pending; privacy adviser), PRIV-LEGAL-APP1-APP5-NOTICE (pending; adviser approves wording, owner supplies accountable organisation, privacy contact and complaints process), PRIV-CLINICAL-PHI-MINIMISATION (partial; owner accepts the current safeguard or asks for a stronger filter). None is a code fix. The Security and compliance thread offered to draft wording for items 1 and 4. PRIOR DETAIL: OWNER REAFFIRMATION 2026-10-06: Confirmed active protective constraint through 2026-12-01. No identifiable patient data may enter the app until external provider and legal approvals close. PRIOR DETAIL (restored 2026-10-09, an earlier update replaced it wholesale): OWNER DECISION 2026-09-25: until the six approvals close, do not enter identifiable patient information into the app (questions go to OpenAI outside Australia). Owner order: (1) clinical PHI-minimisation acceptance by the owner; (2) send the OpenAI and Railway requests already drafted in docs/governance/privacy-completion-drafts-2026-09-13.md after filling in the operator identity and privacy contact (note Railway's public DPA lists 'Sensitive Data: None'); (3) engage a privacy adviser for APP 8 and APP 1/5. PRIOR DETAIL: The PsychSift owner approved the production HMAC control and verified retention schedules on 2026-09-01. Release remains blocked on six items: OpenAI ZDR and countersigned DPA evidence, Railway sensitive-health terms, APP 8 and APP 1/5 privacy-adviser approval, and clinical PHI-minimisation acceptance. Evidence authority: docs/governance/privacy-readiness.v1.json and docs/governance/privacy-closeout-2026-09-01.md.
